title: What Do You Want to Be? Kid Reporters Share Their Dream Jobs
summary:
Do you know what you want to be when you grow up? Or are you still figuring it out? Time for Kids asked its team of Kid Reporters what they want most in a career and how their goals have changed over time. Their answers show that it is perfectly normal for dreams to shift as you grow.

Rosalie used to dream of being a pop star when she was five. Now she wants to be an engineer. Her future career needs to include making cool things, working with animals and being kind to other people. Bevy loves the library and reading. When she grows up, she wants to be a reporter — going on adventures, meeting interesting people and working for a newspaper.

Harlem once wanted to be a princess, with an important role in a kingdom. Her dream now is to be a Supreme Court justice — she still wants to make a difference. Adam loves building with his hands, piece by piece. He is interested in how things are built and how they work, and he would like to solve problems and figure out how to improve things.

Tilda once wanted to be a ballerina. Now she wants to be an architect and a writer. Her future career needs her to be creative, to make things and to be a leader. Molly says her future career will have a big impact on people's lives. It needs to include connecting and interacting with others — and writing, because she truly loves writing down her ideas.

So what about you? Your dream job might change — and that is part of the adventure. The Kid Reporters all want work that matters to them, whether that means building, writing, exploring or helping others. What do you want most in a career?
why_it_matters: Dream jobs change as people grow, and thinking about what matters to you now can help you explore new interests and skills. It also shows there is no single right answer — building, writing, exploring, and helping others can all matter.

keywords.explanation: An engineer is a person who designs and builds things, like machines or bridges.
A reporter is a person who finds out news and tells people about it, often in a newspaper.
A Supreme Court justice is a judge on the highest court in the United States.
An architect is a person who designs buildings.
A ballerina is a woman who dances ballet on stage.
A career is the kind of work a person does for many years.

background_read: A career is the kind of work a person does for many years, and a dream job is the work someone most hopes to do one day.
Children often change their minds about jobs as they grow, because new interests, skills, and experiences shape what feels important to them.
Some jobs are about making things, like engineers and architects, while others are about sharing ideas or helping people, like reporters and writers.
Thinking about what matters most to you, such as building, writing, exploring, or helping others, can help you imagine the kind of work you might enjoy.
